state_design.same_owner: Authenticated current local same owner, explicit current revision and null epoch; update lease_expires_at,updated_at,revision+1 with exact old epoch/client/revision CAS and RowsAffected1. state_design.foreign_expired_or_no_lease: Require authoritative identity and complete original settlement, preserve canonical Task/Run/effect/budget and queue bytes. Existing HandoffEpoch+lease assignment+CLIENT_HANDOFF produces oldepoch+1/revision+2/watermark+1; then BuildSessionSnapshot and COMPLETED in same Tx. No empty owner SQL representation: writer_client_id is NOTNULL nonempty; no lease is SQLNULL lease_expires_at, expired lease still appears as nonnull snapshot writer.
state_design.foreign_valid_owner: B22:137 expressly requires ACK while another same-subject client retains valid writer, followed by settled takeover and final result139. Merely changing current ACK to COMPLETE does not implement this lifecycle. A five/six-path synchronous subset cannot claim this frozen branch complete. Preserve no unsafe transfer; any bounded refusal is declared unsupported branch, not a full contract pass. Root must decide separate durable pending/finalization design before claiming whole attach support.
